title: Big Three Dragons: A z = 7.15 Lyman-break galaxy detected in [O III] 88 μm, [C II] 158 μm, and dust continuum with ALMA
question: What are the kinematic, dust and ISM properties of the z=7.15 LBG B14-65666 from resolved [OIII] 88um, [CII] 158um and dust continuum, and is it a merger?

data.angular_resolution: Band 6 natural 0.29x0.23 arcsec; Briggs 0.23x0.12; Band 8 natural 0.39x0.37

evidence.quote: We have remeasured $z_{\rm Ly\alpha}$ in the spectrum of (cite: furusawa2016)
We adopt $\beta = -1.85^{+0.54}_{-0.53}$ in (cite: bowler2018) calculated with updated $J$- and $H$-band photometry values.

what.value: Compilation of literature Lya velocity offsets, MUV, EW and [CII] luminosities at z~6-8

evidence.quote: We summarize these literature sample at $z\approx6-8$ in Table [\[tab:compilation\]](#tab:compilation).

external_data.citation: (cite: erb2014; nakajima2018) and others in Table 7

recipe.method: CASA pipeline calibration, concat for Band 8, CLEAN imaging (natural and Briggs 0.3), uvcontsub

recipe.goal: Measure line fluxes, sizes, redshifts, FWHM and luminosities
recipe.method: Velocity-integrated maps over ~600 km/s; 2D Gaussian fits with imfit; Gaussian spectral fits; clump decomposition by velocity ranges; L_line from Carilli & Walter relation
key_parameters: Clump velocity ranges [+8,+280] and [-353,-52] km/s relative to z_sys

recipe.method: Virial estimate M_dyn = C r_1/2 sigma^2 / G with C = 6.7, r_1/2 from major semi-axis of 2D Gaussian
assumptions: Uncertain at least by factor of three due to C; virial theorem may not apply

recipe.goal: Dust continuum flux, T_d, L_TIR and M_d
recipe.method: imfit two-component Gaussians at fixed clump positions; modified blackbody with CMB correction at fixed beta_d (1.5, 1.75, 2.0); L_TIR over 8-1000 um; dust mass with kappa0 = 10 cm2/g at 250 um
assumptions: kappa0 = 10 cm2 g-1 at 250 um (Hildebrand 1983); using Dunne 2000 doubles M_d
Clumps assumed to have same T_d, beta_d as whole system

recipe.goal: IRX-beta and [OIII]/[CII] vs L_bol comparison with literature
recipe.method: Uniform beta and L_UV for 11 z>6.5 galaxies, L_TIR assuming T_d = 50 K, beta_d = 1.5; compared to Calzetti and SMC curves (intrinsic beta -2.2)
assumptions: T_d = 50 K, beta_d = 1.5 for literature sample

recipe.method: GALAXEV BC03 with nebular emission, Calzetti law, Chabrier IMF, constant SFH, z fixed 7.1520, [OIII] flux and dust continuum included; least chi2 of Sawicki 2012; Monte Carlo N=300 errors
assumptions: Constant SFH; Calzetti attenuation same for stellar and nebular; Chabrier IMF 0.1-100 Msun

recipe.method: Gaussian peak of Lya in FOCAS spectrum; dv = c(zLya - zsys)/(1+zsys); Spearman rank tests on 17-galaxy z~6-8 compilation
key_parameters: vacuum rest wavelength 1215.67 A; systematic ±100 km/s

evidence.quote: We obtain $(11.0\pm1.4) \times 10^{8}$ $L_{\rm \odot}$ and $(34.4\pm4.1) \times 10^{8}$ $L_{\rm \odot}$ for the [Cii] and [Oiii] luminosity
We obtain $(11.0\pm1.4) \times 10^{8}$ $L_{\rm \odot}$ and $(34.4\pm4.1) \times 10^{8}$ $L_{\rm \odot}$ for the [Cii] and [Oiii] luminosity
the velocity offset of the two clumps is $177\pm16$ km s$^{-1}$
we obtain the best-fit $T_{\rm d}$ values of 61 K, 54 K, and 48 K for $\beta_{\rm d}=$ 1.5, 1.75, and 2.0
we obtain the total dynamical mass of ($8.8\pm1.9) \times 10^{10}$ $M_{\rm \odot}$
Therefore, we adopt IRX $=0.5^{+0.3}_{-0.1}$ as a fiducial value.
a very high current SFR, $200^{+82}_{-38}$ $M_{\rm \odot}$ yr$^{-1}$
Hereafter we adopt $\Delta v_{\rm Ly\alpha}$ $= 772\pm45\pm100$ km s$^{-1}$.
